title: IELTS Speaking Collocations Collection
summary: A collection of 1,500 real-life English collocations across 15 distinct topics designed for IELTS Speaking B2–C1 vocabulary practice.

concepts.name: Collocation
concepts.summary: A natural combination of words frequently used together in spoken English, essential for achieving natural fluency in IELTS Speaking.

concepts.name: Daily Routines
concepts.summary: Practical phrases and expressions used to describe everyday schedules, time management, and habits.

concepts.name: Decision Making
concepts.summary: Expressions related to evaluating options, assessing risks, and handling unexpected problems or dilemmas.
